notes: WATCHMAN Left Atrial Appendage Closure Technology for Embolic Protection in AF. Non-inferior to warfarin for stroke/systemic embolism (3.0 vs 4.9 per 100 pt-yrs). Procedural complications 7.4%. First LAA device.

Prospective Randomized Evaluation of the WATCHMAN LAA Closure Device. Primary endpoint: did NOT meet non-inferiority (RR 1.07). But efficacy endpoint met. Safety improved vs PROTECT-AF. Led to FDA approval.
LAA closure vs NOACs in AF. Non-inferior for stroke/TIA/systemic embolism/CV death (10.6% vs 13.1%, p=0.004 for non-inferiority). First trial vs DOACs. LAA closure alternative to DOACs.
Patients with AF contraindication to anticoagulation. LAA closure reduced stroke vs antiplatelet (2.3% vs 7.3% per year). For patients who can't take anticoagulation, LAA closure option.
